060   private static final ThreadLocal<byte[]> BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE = (isTrue(env("juneau.disableIoBufferReuse", false)) ? null : new ThreadLocal<>());
061   private static final ThreadLocal<char[]> CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE = (isTrue(env("juneau.disableIoBufferReuse", false)) ? null : new ThreadLocal<>());

072   /**
073    * Cleans up thread-local buffer caches for the current thread.
074    *
075    * <p>
076    * This method should be called when a thread is finished using the buffer caches to prevent memory leaks
077    * in thread pool environments where threads are reused.
078    */
079   public static void cleanupThreadLocals() {
080      if (BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE != null) {
081         BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE.remove();
082      }
083      if (CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE != null) {
084         CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE.remove();
085      }
086   }

104   /**
105    * Close all specified input streams, output streams, readers, and writers.
106    *
107    * @param o
108    *    The list of all objects to close.
109    *    <jk>null</jk> entries are ignored.
110    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
111    */
112   public static void close(Object...o) throws IOException {
113      IOException ex = null;
114      for (var o2 : o) {
115         try {
116            if (o2 instanceof InputStream o3)
117               o3.close();
118            if (o2 instanceof OutputStream o3)
119               o3.close();
120            if (o2 instanceof Reader o3)
121               o3.close();
122            if (o2 instanceof Writer o3)
123               o3.close();
124         } catch (IOException e) {
125            ex = e;
126         }
127      }
128      if (isNotNull(ex))
129         throw ex;
130   }
131
132   /**
133    * Reads and discards the remainder of a reader or input stream, ignoring any exceptions.
134    *
135    * <p>
136    * Reads until end-of-stream using a 256-unit buffer.  Any {@link IOException} stops the drain silently.
137    * No-op if the object is <jk>null</jk> or is neither a {@link Reader} nor an {@link InputStream}.
138    * The stream is not closed.
139    *
140    * @param in The reader or input stream to drain.
141    */
142   public static void drainQuietly(Closeable in) {
143      try {
144         if (in instanceof Reader r) {
145            var buf = new char[256];
146            while (r.read(buf) != -1) { /* discard */ }
147         } else if (in instanceof InputStream is) {
148            var buf = new byte[256];
149            while (is.read(buf) != -1) { /* discard */ }
150         }
151      } catch (IOException ignored) {
152         // best-effort
153      }
154   }

174   public static void closeQuietly(Object...o) {

226   /**
227    * Counts the number of bytes in the input stream and then closes the stream.
228    *
229    * @param is The input stream to read from.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <c>0</c>).
230    * @return The number of bytes read.
231    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
232    */
233   public static long count(InputStream is) throws IOException {
234      if (is == null)
235         return 0;
236      var c = 0l;
237      var i = 0l;
238      try {
239         while ((i = is.skip(1024)) != 0)
240            c += i;
241      } finally {
242         is.close();
243      }
244      return c;
245   }
246
247   /**
248    * Counts the number of characters in the reader and then closes the reader.
249    *
250    * @param r The reader to read from.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <c>0</c>).
251    * @return The number of characters read.
252    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
253    */
254   public static long count(Reader r) throws IOException {
255      if (r == null)
256         return 0;
257      var c = 0l;
258      var i = 0l;
259      try {
260         while ((i = r.skip(1024)) != 0)
261            c += i;
262      } finally {
263         r.close();
264      }
265      return c;
266   }

268   /**
269    * Flushes multiple output streams and writers in a single call.
270    *
271    * @param o
272    *    The objects to flush.
273    *    <jk>null</jk> entries are ignored.
274    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
275    */
276   public static void flush(Object...o) throws IOException {
277      IOException ex = null;
278      for (var o2 : o) {
279         try {
280            if (o2 instanceof OutputStream o3)
281               o3.flush();
282            if (o2 instanceof Writer o3)
283               o3.flush();
284         } catch (IOException e) {
285            ex = e;
286         }
287      }
288      if (isNotNull(ex))
289         throw ex;
290   }

292   /**
293    * Loads a text file from either the file system or classpath.
294    *
295    * @param name The file name.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
296    * @param paths The paths to search.
297    * @return The file contents, or <jk>null</jk> if not found.
298    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
299    */
300   public static String loadSystemResourceAsString(String name, String...paths) throws IOException {
301      for (var path : paths) {
302         var p = new File(path);
303         if (p.exists()) {
304            var f = new File(p, name);
305            if (f.exists() && f.canRead())
306               return read(f);
307         }
308      }
309      var cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
310      if (cl == null)
311         cl = ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader();
312      for (var path : paths) {
313         var n = eq(path, ".") ? name : path + '/' + name;
314         try (var is = cl.getResourceAsStream(n)) {
315            if (isNotNull(is))
316               return read(is);
317         }
318         try (var is = ClassLoader.getSystemResourceAsStream(n)) {
319            if (isNotNull(is))
320               return read(is);
321         }
322      }
323      return null;
324   }
325
326   /**
327    * Pipes the contents of the specified <c>Reader</c> to the specified <c>Writer</c> a line at a time.
328    *
329    * <p>
330    * Writer is flushed after every line.  Typically useful when writing to consoles.
331    *
332    * @param in
333    *    The reader to pipe from.
334    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <c>0</c>).
335    *    <br>Reader is automatically closed.
336    * @param out
337    *    The file to write the output to.
338    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <c>0</c>).
339    *    <br>Writer is flushed but not automatically closed.
340    * @return
341    *    The number of characters piped.
342    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
343    */
344   public static long pipeLines(Reader in, Writer out) throws IOException {
345      if (in == null || out == null)
346         return 0;
347      var total = 0l;
348      try (var in2 = in) {
349         try (var s = new Scanner(in2)) {
350            while (s.hasNextLine()) {
351               var l = s.nextLine();
352               if (isNotNull(l)) {
353                  out.write(l);
354                  out.write("\n");
355                  out.flush();
356                  total += l.length() + 1;
357               }
358            }
359         }
360      }
361      return total;
362   }

559   /**

565    *    <ul>
566    *       <li>{@link Reader}
567    *       <li>{@link InputStream}
568    *       <li>{@link File}
569    *       <li>byte array.
570    *    </ul>
571    * @return The input converted to a string, or <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
572    * @throws IOException If thrown from output stream.
573    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the input is non-<jk>null</jk> but not one of the supported types.
574    */
575   public static String read(Object in) throws IOException {
576      if (in == null)
577         return null;
578      if (in instanceof Reader in2)
579         return read(in2);
580      if (in instanceof InputStream in2)
581         return read(in2);
582      if (in instanceof File in2)
583         return read(in2);
584      if (in instanceof byte[] in2)
585         return read(in2);
586      throw iaex("Invalid type passed to read:  %s", ClassUtils.className(in));
587   }

649   /**
650    * Reads the specified input into a {@link String} until the end of the input is reached.
651    *
652    * @param in
653    *    The input reader.
654    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk>.
655    *    <br>String is automatically closed.
656    * @param expectedLength
657    *    Specify a positive number if the length of the input is known, or <c>-1</c> if unknown.
658    * @return
659    *    The contents of the reader as a string, or <jk>null</jk> if the reader was <jk>null</jk>.
660    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred trying to read from the reader.
661    */
662   public static String read(Reader in, long expectedLength) throws IOException {
663      if (in == null)
664         return null;
665      try (var in2 = in) {
666         var sb = new StringBuilder(buffSize(expectedLength)); // Assume they're ASCII characters.
667         var buf = charBuffer((int)expectedLength);
668         var i = 0;
669         while ((i = in2.read(buf)) != -1)
670            sb.append(buf, 0, i);
671         return sb.toString();
672      }
673   }

693    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns an empty array).
694    * @param maxBytes
695    *    The maximum number of bytes to read, or <jk>-1</jk> to read all bytes.
696    * @return The contents of the file as a byte array.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
697    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
698    */
699   public static byte[] readBytes(File in, int maxBytes) throws IOException {
700      if (in == null || ! (in.exists() && in.canRead()))
701         return new byte[0];
702      try (var is = new FileInputStream(in)) {
703         return readBytes(is, maxBytes);
704      }
705   }

729    *    <br>Stream is not automatically closed.

742         buff.write(b, 0, nRead);
743      buff.flush();
744      return buff.toByteArray();
745   }

765   /**
766    * Inflates (decompresses) the specified compressed bytes with a hard ceiling on the total output size and an
767    * effective output-to-input ratio guard.
768    *
769    * <p>
770    * Building on the bounded-copy family in this class (such as {@link #readBytes(InputStream,int)} and
771    * {@link #pipe(InputStream,OutputStream,long)}), this method decompresses untrusted input without letting a
772    * small compressed payload expand into an unbounded allocation.  Two independent limits are enforced
773    * <i>during</i> inflation, so a violating stream is aborted before its full output is ever materialized:
774    * <ul>
775    *    <li><b>Absolute cap.</b> If the running output size would exceed <jv>maxOutputBytes</jv>, an
776    *       {@link IOException} is thrown.
777    *    <li><b>Ratio guard.</b> If the running output size would exceed <jv>maxRatio</jv> times the compressed
778    *       input length, an {@link IOException} is thrown &mdash; this catches a highly-compressible payload even
779    *       when the absolute cap is generous.
780    * </ul>
781    *
782    * @param compressed
783    *    The compressed input bytes.
784    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns an empty array).
785    * @param nowrap
786    *    Pass <jk>true</jk> for a raw (headerless) DEFLATE stream, or <jk>false</jk> for a zlib-wrapped stream.
787    *    <br>Must match the format used to compress the input.
788    * @param maxOutputBytes
789    *    The maximum number of decompressed bytes to allow.
790    *    <br>Values <c>&lt;= 0</c> disable the absolute cap (mirroring the <c>maxLength</c> convention used
791    *    elsewhere); the ratio guard, if enabled, still applies.
792    * @param maxRatio
793    *    The maximum allowed ratio of output size to compressed input size.
794    *    <br>Values <c>&lt;= 0</c> disable the ratio guard.
795    * @return The decompressed bytes.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
796    * @throws IOException
797    *    If the input is not valid for the selected format, or if either the absolute cap or the ratio guard is
798    *    exceeded.
799    * @since 10.0.0
800    */
801   public static byte[] inflate(byte[] compressed, boolean nowrap, long maxOutputBytes, int maxRatio) throws IOException {
802      if (compressed == null || compressed.length == 0)
803         return new byte[0];
804      var cap = maxOutputBytes <= 0 ? Long.MAX_VALUE : maxOutputBytes;
805      var ratioLimit = maxRatio <= 0 ? Long.MAX_VALUE : (long)compressed.length * maxRatio;
806      var inflater = new Inflater(nowrap);
807      // Inflater isn't AutoCloseable at this module's source/target level, so route end() through
808      // try-with-resources via a Closeable method reference (inflate() already declares throws IOException).
809      try (Closeable end = inflater::end) {
810         inflater.setInput(compressed);
811         return inflateAll(inflater, cap, ratioLimit, maxRatio);
812      }
813   }
814
815   private static byte[] inflateAll(Inflater inflater, long cap, long ratioLimit, int maxRatio) throws IOException {
816      var out = new ByteArrayOutputStream(BUFF_SIZE);
817      var buf = new byte[BUFF_SIZE];
818      var total = 0L;
819      while (true) {
820         var n = inflateChunk(inflater, buf);
821         if (n > 0) {
822            total += n;
823            checkInflateLimits(total, cap, ratioLimit, maxRatio);
824            out.write(buf, 0, n);
825         } else if (inflater.finished() || inflater.needsDictionary() || inflater.needsInput()) {
826            break;
827         }
828      }
829      return out.toByteArray();
830   }
831
832   private static int inflateChunk(Inflater inflater, byte[] buf) throws IOException {
833      try {
834         return inflater.inflate(buf);
835      } catch (DataFormatException e) {
836         throw ioex(e, "Invalid compressed data");
837      }
838   }
839
840   private static void checkInflateLimits(long total, long cap, long ratioLimit, int maxRatio) throws IOException {
841      if (total > cap)
842         throw ioex("Inflated output exceeds maximum allowed %s bytes", cap);
843      if (total > ratioLimit)
844         throw ioex("Inflated output-to-input ratio exceeds maximum allowed %s", maxRatio);
845   }

847   /**
848    * Wraps the specified reader in a buffered reader.
849    *
850    * @param r The reader being wrapped.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
851    * @return
852    *    The reader wrapped in a {@link BufferedReader}, or the original {@link Reader} if it's already a buffered
853    *    reader, or <jk>null</jk> if the argument was <jk>null</jk>.
854    */
855   public static Reader toBufferedReader(Reader r) {
856      if (r == null || r instanceof BufferedReader || r instanceof StringReader)
857         return r;
858      return new BufferedReader(r);
859   }

861   private static int buffSize(long max) {
862      return (max > 0 && max < BUFF_SIZE) ? (int)max : BUFF_SIZE;
863   }
864
865   private static byte[] byteBuffer(int maxBytes) {
866      if (isNotNull(BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE)) {
867         var x = BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE.get();
868         if (x == null) {
869            x = new byte[BUFF_SIZE];
870            BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE.set(x);
871            BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE_MISSES.incrementAndGet();
872         } else {
873            BYTE_BUFFER_CACHE_HITS.incrementAndGet();
874         }
875         return x;
876      }
877      return new byte[buffSize(maxBytes)];
878   }
879
880   private static char[] charBuffer(int maxChars) {
881      if (isNotNull(CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE)) {
882         var x = CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE.get();
883         if (x == null) {
884            x = new char[BUFF_SIZE];
885            CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE.set(x);
886            CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE_MISSES.incrementAndGet();
887         } else {
888            CHAR_BUFFER_CACHE_HITS.incrementAndGet();
889         }
890         return x;
891      }
892      return new char[buffSize(maxChars)];
893   }

899   /** Pipes bytes to output stream.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */
900   public static long pipe(byte[] in, OutputStream out, int maxBytes) throws IOException {
901      if (in == null || out == null)
902         return 0;
903      var length = (maxBytes < 0 || maxBytes > in.length) ? in.length : maxBytes;
904      out.write(in, 0, length);
905      return length;
906   }
907
908   /** Pipes input stream to output stream.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */
909   public static long pipe(InputStream in, OutputStream out) throws IOException {
910      try (var in2 = in) {
911         return pipe(in, out, -1L);
912      }
913   }

915   /** Pipes input stream to output stream with exception handler.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>.  <br><jv>onException</jv> must not be <jk>null</jk> (invoked on I/O error). */
916   public static long pipe(InputStream in, OutputStream out, Consumer<IOException> onException) {
917      try {
918         try (var in2 = in) {
919            return pipe(in, out, -1L);
920         }
921      } catch (IOException e) {
922         onException.accept(e);
923         return -1;
924      }
925   }
926
927   /** Pipes input stream to output stream with max bytes.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */
928   public static long pipe(InputStream in, OutputStream out, long maxBytes) throws IOException {
929      if (in == null || out == null)
930         return 0;
931      var buffer = byteBuffer((int)maxBytes);
932      int readLen;
933      var total = 0l;
934      if (maxBytes < 0) {
935         while ((readLen = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
936            out.write(buffer, 0, readLen);
937            total += readLen;
938         }
939      } else {
940         var remaining = maxBytes;
941         while (remaining > 0) {
942            readLen = in.read(buffer, 0, buffSize(remaining));
943            if (readLen == -1)
944               break;
945            out.write(buffer, 0, readLen);
946            total += readLen;
947            remaining -= readLen;
948         }
949      }
950      out.flush();
951      return total;
952   }

954   /** Pipes input stream to writer.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */
955   public static long pipe(InputStream in, Writer out) throws IOException {
956      if (in == null || out == null)
957         return 0;
958      return pipe(new InputStreamReader(in, UTF8), out);
959   }

982   /** Pipes reader to output stream.  <br>Returns <c>0</c> if either <jv>in</jv> or <jv>out</jv> is <jk>null</jk>. */
983   public static long pipe(Reader in, OutputStream out) throws IOException {
984      if (in == null || out == null)
985         return 0;
986      var total = 0l;
987      try (var in2 = in) {
988         var osw = new OutputStreamWriter(out, UTF8);
989         var i = 0;
990         var b = charBuffer(-1);
991         while ((i = in.read(b)) > 0) {
992            total += i;
993            osw.write(b, 0, i);
994         }
995         osw.flush();
996      }
997      return total;
998   }
